description: Phase 9 enterprise integration. CrowdStrike AI Defense Runtime commit bridge. MUST/MUST NOT rules: (1) MUST check ZO-SENTINEL verdict before forwarding commit to AiDr. (2) MUST NOT auto-commit MCPs with verdict CAUTION_LIMITED or HIGH_RISK_ISOLATED without explicit override. (3) MUST include injection_resilience score in commit payload. (4) MUST route verdict-check through inference_router on :8773. (5) MUST NOT call AiDr API directly from daemons — all external I/O through this gateway. (6) MUST log all commit decisions to audit_log. Cites PROMPT_INJECTION_PLAN.md explicitly. No blocking input() calls.
